rh.code_paper_alignment.methodology_matc.reason: The stated audit methodology includes an exact-gradient check on one minibatch per audit and claims empirical unbiasedness verification for every estimator. The executed Neyman audit instead computes covariance only: its code never obtains or compares an oracle gradient. This contradicts the described verification procedure for the headline estimator, independently of whether that estimator is mathematically unbiased.
